events.title: Japanese islands brace for Dujuan to become a typhoon again
events.description: Storm system expected to hit Izu Islands as it strengthens. Meanwhile, Atlantic hurricane season is unusually quiet Tropical Storm Dujuan is skirting the coast of Japan and despite avoiding a direct landfall, is still expected to leave its mark. Dujuan briefly reached typhoon status on Friday before weakening to a tropical storm again on Sunday morning. But it is expected to restrengthen back to a typhoon by Tuesday morning. Sustained winds could reach 80mph (129km/h), with gusts approaching 100mph. Although mainland Japan has avoided a direct hit, Dujuan’s track takes it across the Izu Islands, where evacuation warnings are in place. Heavy rain, flooding and landslide alerts are widespread, with high waves adding another threat to exposed coastal areas and islands. Continue reading...

events.title: The United Nations General Assembly is meeting. Is it accomplishing anything?
events.description: NPR's Mary Louise Kelly speaks with Michael Froman, Council on Foreign Relations president, at the UN General Assembly.

events.title: China's 13-year-old swimming star raises questions on child athletes
events.description: Three gold medals and three Asian Games records have catapulted China's Yu Zidi, 13, into the sporting spotlight. She is far from the first teen prodigy, but should teens be competing at elite level?

events.title: As the EU advances free trade with Southeast Asia, why is there no ASEAN-wide deal?
events.description: After years of arduous negotiations, the EU is closing on a string of bilateral trade deals with countries in Southeast Asia. And yet, a bloc-to-bloc agreement between the EU and ASEAN remains a distant prospect.

events.title: Hungary: EU Commission wants to unblock €4.2b in funding
events.description: The Commission's president has argued that Budapest is strengthening the rule of law with Viktor Orban finally out of office. Funds had been blocked over corruption allegations under Hungary's former government.

events.title: Campus Project 2026: Georgia Takes Center Stage
events.description: The Beethovenfest exchange project brings German and Georgian musical traditions together. And the reasons go beyond music.

events.title: Germany news: Call to scrap once-a-day gas price rises
events.description: The ADAC motoring association says a once-a-day rule on gas price changes has failed to help drivers' wallets. Entry-level jobs are becoming scarcer, making things hard for those entering the job market. DW has more.

events.title: Pope Leo XIV to trace back French ancestry, spiritual roots on visit to France
events.description: Pope Leo’s four-day visit to France, which kicks off on Friday, is something of a homecoming for the Chicago-born pontiff, a grandson of European immigrants with family roots in Normandy. His spiritual roots in French Catholicism run deeper still.

events.title: Film show: Brad Pitt and his dog take on the wilderness in 'Heart of the Beast'
events.description: Eve Jackson and film critic Emma Jones run through this week's new cinema releases in France. Brad Pitt heads into the Alaskan wilderness with his four-legged co-star in "Heart of the Beast". Also, Robert Pattinson takes on a controversial TV host in "Primetime", a new generation discovers "Sense and Sensibility", and Julia Donaldson and Axel Scheffler's "The Scarecrows' Wedding" arrives on the big screen.

events.title: UN General Assembly enters second day with key speeches ahead
events.description: It’s Day Two of the United Nations General Assembly in New York, with a packed programme including speeches by Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian and Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky. Some of the biggest names in artificial intelligence will also address the UN Security Council. France 24’s Jessica Le Masurier is covering the gathering for us.

events.title: What to know about the deal by Britain to surrender the Chagos Islands
events.description: The fate of the Chagos Islands hinges on U.S. support for a sovereignty transfer from Britain to Mauritius

events.title: Executive linked to alleged financial misconduct is freed from jail in Myanmar
events.description: An Australian business executive who headed the American Chamber of Commerce in Myanmar has been released after spending more than 100 days in jail over allegations of financial misconduct

events.title: What to know about the agreement signed by President Trump and the leaders of Denmark and Greenland
events.description: U.S. President Donald Trump and the leaders of Denmark and Greenland have signed an agreement about Greenland's status

events.title: Argentina’s leaderless opposition struggles to unite against Milei's reelection bid
events.description: President Javier Milei has brought down inflation in Argentina, but economic pain is giving his Peronist opponents a new opening ahead of the 2027 election

events.title: Taiwan watching closely as Xi and Trump meet and hopes US will keep up its arms sales
events.description: Taiwan is expressing confidence that U.S. arms sales to the island will continue despite China's pressure as China’s Xi Jinping arrives in Washington to meet with U.S. President Donald Trump

events.title: UN health agency calls for investment boost to save young lives from cancer
events.description: More children and young people are beating cancer, but progress remains uneven across regions and age groups, highlighting the need for increased investment to boost survival rates.

events.title: ‘Ask us first’: Children demand a voice on AI’s future
events.description: The first generation to grow up with AI may also be the last one anyone thinks to ask about it – and that has to change, the UN's top human rights official said on Tuesday.

events.title: Trump defends military action against Iran, Venezuela, and calls for rebrand of AI
events.description: US President Donald Trump used his address to the UN General Assembly on Tuesday to defend recent military action against Iran, urging countries to maintain economic pressure on Tehran – and declaring that he now faces a choice between making a deal, or taking far more drastic steps.

events.title: Time to accept ‘hard truths’ so trust can be rebuilt: General Assembly President
events.description: The UN’s survival for 80 years is not, by itself, proof of success, and now, the institution must confront painful truths if it hopes to rebuild public trust, said Khalilur Rahman, president of the General Assembly’s 81st session on Tuesday.

events.title: In Tanzania, the sea is moving inland – and taking livelihoods with it
events.description: Along the coast of Tanzania, in East Africa, the Indian Ocean is pushing saltwater ever farther inland, shrinking coconut harvests, driving fish away and leaving some residents wondering how much longer they can stay.

events.title: New Jersey police pull out 3-foot python from woman's car grille, bodycam video shows
events.description: Body camera footage shows New Jersey police dismantling a car's front bumper to free a 3-foot ball python wedged inside the vehicle's grille.

events.title: Chinese President Xi set to arrive in DC for high-stakes Trump summit and more top headlines
events.description: Get all the stories you need-to-know from the most powerful name in news delivered first thing every morning to your inbox.

events.title: Massachusetts lesbian bar ignites fury after easing mask rules for one night a week
events.description: Last Ditch Bar in Greenfield, Massachusetts, faces a boycott and accusations of ableism after lifting its mask mandate on Saturdays to stay afloat.

events.title: Two Ole Miss students found dead as packaged kratom is recovered at two sites: officials
events.description: Two University of Mississippi students were found dead at separate locations as Lafayette County Metro Narcotics investigates kratom from a retail store.

events.title: Man scales locked gate in chilling video after allegedly chasing college student home, then walks free: police
events.description: Security video shows a man scaling a locked gate to follow a UC Berkeley student into her apartment complex after allegedly chasing her home.

events.title: Bryan Kohberger didn't understand what he was doing when he pleaded guilty: unsealed memo
events.description: Bryan Kohberger's former attorneys said he struggled to rationally understand court proceedings before his guilty plea in the Idaho murders case.

events.title: Impeached Georgia mayor speaks out after sexting, spending scandals result in ouster
events.description: Ex-Stockbridge, Georgia Mayor Jayden Williams, 23, who was ousted earlier this month, told WSB-TV that he did not expect to be booted out of office.

events.title: Lukashenko reveals bizarre argument he and Putin have over who is the ‘bigger dictator’
events.description: Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko told a youth forum that he and Vladimir Putin regularly argue over who is the bigger dictator.

events.title: Chinese Coast Guard rams Philippine boat in South China Sea, sparking diplomatic clash
events.description: A Chinese Coast Guard vessel collided with a Philippine government ship in the South China Sea Friday, sparking a diplomatic dispute between Beijing, Manila and the U.S.

events.title: Italian PM pushes foreign student cap in classrooms, burqa, niqab ban in schools
events.description: Giorgia Meloni's proposed legislation would cap foreign students per classroom and ban burqas and niqabs in Italian schools to foster integration.
